Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and subsequent concussion
symptoms. Over the course of care, the patient attneded 25 visits for evaluation and management. The reported injury is
consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency
decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was progressively discharged from active care. Examination findings were
mixed: several findings, including symptom-related and vestibular observations, support the diagnosis of concussion, while other
neurological and imaging-related tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the
patient's history. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplictae or repeated charges for the same services. Overall, the
clinical picture supports a diagnosis of concussion related to the collision, with recovery progresisng as expected.
